ChatGPT said:ChatGPT

To enable two-factor authentication (2FA) on GitHub:

  1. Sign in at github.com.

  2. Click your profile picture in the upper-right corner.

  3. Select Settings.

  4. In the left sidebar, click Password and authentication.

  5. Find Two-factor authentication and click Enable two-factor authentication.

  6. Choose Authenticator app (recommended).

  7. Open an authenticator app on your phone, such as Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator.

  8. Scan the QR code displayed by GitHub.

  9. Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app to complete setup.

Important: Save your recovery codes

GitHub will provide recovery codes. Download and store them somewhere secure, such as your password manager. They allow you to regain access if you lose your phone.

You can also configure a passkey as an additional sign-in method.

Once GitHub confirms that 2FA is enabled, tell me and we'll create the repository for your Morning Trading Brief calculator.
